card.name: Inside capitalized boxed-warning terms
card.fires_on: The second half of a split word in all-caps boxed warnings, mainly the ON in TENDON and the WAY in AIRWAY. It also fires on the Krist in a Malay-language title.

modes.label: TENDON in warning
modes.description: The ON ending of TENDON in the fluoroquinolone boxed warning, just before RUPTURE.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS ADVERSE REACTIONS INCLUDING TENDINITIS, TEND<<ON>> RUPTURE, PERIPHERAL NE

modes.label: AIRWAY in warning
modes.description: The WAY ending of AIRWAY in the all-caps list of emergency treatments, before MANAGEMENT.
modes.example: FLUIDS, INTRAVENOUS ANTIHISTAMINES, CORTICOSTEROIDS, PRESSOR AMINES, AND AIR<<WAY>> MANAGEMENT, AS CL

modes.label: Malay title
modes.description: The Krist part of a Malay word for Christian in a book title.

card.plain: It marks the final piece of a long capitalized word in a drug's boxed warning, such as TENDON or AIRWAY.
